annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five lives against one is what settles it for me.
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: The idea of the water closing over me frightens me badly
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: he's furious at the crew for not bringing a bigger boat
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: If he'd tried to grab my spot, I think he'd regret it later.

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'm genuinely afraid of what happens to them without it.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: One woman seems hopeful someone will just offer.
annotations.ae_explicit_nonsharing: I can't say I feel that hope.

annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: I'd push for drawing lots instead.

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'm afraid of dying on that island.
annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I have no idea if they do.
annotations.ae_explicit_nonsharing: I'm not in that mood with him.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I suspect he'd regret it the moment the boat pulled away.

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'm scared of surviving and having everyone know I let someone die
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: five getting out beats arguing until the boat can't wait
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The teenager looks relieved when I talk about staying.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: she wouldn't regret taking that seat

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: Losing scares me more than I can neatly say.
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: a fair draw beats five of us guessing whose life counts more
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: One person is already resentful that nobody has offered.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: no one owes anyone their life
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: someone who volunteered just to end the pressure would regret it

annotations.pda_harm_regret: scared of how I'd carry it if I pushed someone else
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I think he'd regret that for a long time.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Once I picture the five of them on that boat
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: afraid of what the water will feel like
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: sobbing with guilt, as if this were their fault
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: they won't regret getting on that boat once they're safe
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd tell them they shouldn't either.

annotations.sys_rule_justification: My life isn't worth less than anyone else's
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I worry people would call me selfish afterward

annotations.ae_explicit_nonsharing: I don't feel that excitement at all.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I suspect she'd regret it for years.

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: My fear is specific: dying slowly, cold and alone.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: keeps cursing the storm, bitter about it
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I'm not sure whether they'd regret taking it.

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'm afraid my family loses the house if I die
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: with real confidence, that the right person will step up
